verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's API docs state that anything you can do in the dashboard can also be done via the Admin/Management API, covering create, update and delete of projects, environments, flags, segments and users. A CLI with raw API access and an official MCP server, both built on that API, reinforce the parity claim. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of full UI/API parity, and a discoverable machine-readable API spec (probes of the docs-site OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Anything you can do in the Flagsmith dashboard, you can also do via the Admin API.
Purpose: Creating, updating, and deleting projects, environments, flags, segments, and users.
The CLI covers flags, segments, features, organisations, projects, environments, SDK-style flag evaluation, and raw API access.
